schema.name: academic_sessions
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE academic_sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, school_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schools(id), name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, current_term INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(current_term BETWEEN 1 AND 3))

schema.name: academic_terms
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE academic_terms (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number BETWEEN 1 AND 3), title TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(session_id,number))

schema.name: access_rules
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE access_rules (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: announcements
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE announcements (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: app_settings
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE app_settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: assessment_attempts
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE assessment_attempts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: assignments
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE assignments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, teacher_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: audit_logs
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE audit_logs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: auth_sessions
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE auth_sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: classes
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE classes (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

schema.name: course_weeks
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE course_weeks (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, week_number INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(course_id,week_number))

schema.name: courses
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE courses (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(term BETWEEN 1 AND 3), UNIQUE(session_id,class_id,subject_id,term))

schema.name: discussion_replies
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE discussion_replies (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, discussion_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES discussions(id), author_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id), position INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: discussions
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE discussions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: enrolments
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE enrolments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), UNIQUE(student_id,session_id))

schema.name: files
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE files (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: lesson_releases
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE lesson_releases (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: lessons
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE lessons (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, week_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course_weeks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, lesson_key TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(week_id,lesson_key))

schema.name: marking_history
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE marking_history (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, submission_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES submissions(id), teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: notifications
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE notifications (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: practice_attempts
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE practice_attempts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: progress
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE progress (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: question_items
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE question_items (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, week_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course_weeks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, lesson_id TEXT REFERENCES lessons(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, question_key TEXT NOT NULL, stage TEXT NOT NULL, difficulty TEXT NOT NULL, question_type TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: recovery_tokens
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE recovery_tokens (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: reflections
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE reflections (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: resources
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE resources (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: schema_migrations
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (version TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: schools
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE schools (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, motto TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: score_history
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE score_history (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, score_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scores(id), teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: scores
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE scores (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: student_presence
schema.definition:
CREATE TABLE student_presence (
 user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),
 last_seen TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: subjects
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE subjects (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

schema.name: submission_versions
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE submission_versions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, submission_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES submissions(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: submissions
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE submissions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), term INTEGER NOT NULL, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), assignment_id TEXT REFERENCES assignments(id), content TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: teacher_assignments
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE teacher_assignments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_sessions(id), class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), UNIQUE(teacher_id,session_id,class_id,subject_id))

schema.name: users
schema.definition: CREATE TABLE users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, school_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schools(id), email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, name TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('ADMIN','TEACHER','STUDENT')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','PENDING','SUSPENDED','DEACTIVATED','REJECTED','REMOVED')), password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, profile TEXT NOT NULL)
